rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Supportive Rage
card.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've spilled paint on my sofa. Stay there; I'll get a cloth. We can fix this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the carpet too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep blotting. You're doing well. That carpet was my birthday present.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cloth's spreading it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right. Good catch. Take my clean shirt. I am absolutely furious, but you are not tackling this alone.

card.title: Supportive Rage
card.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take your time choosing lunch. I'll drive wherever you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we try the place across town?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You should enjoy your birthday lunch. I'm annoyed we paid to park here, but let's go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They only take cash. We'll need to come back for my wallet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the cash. Choose something lovely. I need one minute to be furious before I start the car.

card.title: Terms and Conditions
card.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll lend you the ladder for two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need it for five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One lift, then. And tell your wife my roses have improved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just pay you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Five pounds. Three if you say we're still friends when you hand it over.

card.title: Terms and Conditions
card.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll accept your apology for breaking my blender if you replace it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't afford a new one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Secondhand, then. With six months of being careful around my things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can promise to ask before borrowing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Make that a year and I'll include forgiveness for the missing lid.

card.title: Yes, but My Way
card.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll help you move. I've brought moral support.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need someone to carry the sofa.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I'll encourage that person enthusiastically.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to bring muscle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My jaw's a muscle. You're doing wonderfully.

card.title: Yes, but My Way
card.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely, I'll look after your dog this weekend. Book his usual kennel and I'll check their photos.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant he'd stay at your house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Bring his bed and enough food. I'll enjoy the company.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needs walking at six every morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll leave you a key so you can collect him without waking me.

card.title: The Pattern
card.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two office biscuits are missing. We've got an organised operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ate them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A confession this quick suggests training.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was hungry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they're recruiting through hunger. This goes higher than the biscuit tin.

card.title: The Pattern
card.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift's slow and my email's late. Everything's being delayed deliberately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The email's still in your drafts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've reached the sending stage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't pressed send.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. The system has recruited me.

card.title: Could You Just…
card.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you hold this shelf while I find the screws?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could you put those screws in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There. Anything else?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just the books. And the matching shelf beside it.

card.title: Could You Just…
card.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you address this wedding envelope? Your writing's neater.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. I'm only doing one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Could you slip the invitation inside that one?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in. You've forgotten the reply card.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. Could you pop that in, seal it and add a stamp? Then I'll have a finished example to copy.

card.title: One Last Thing
card.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, could you check this window latch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's shut. Goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why's the curtain moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The fan's on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you show me which switch? There are several.

card.title: One Last Thing
card.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just one last cup to dry before your taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. My taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you reach the shelf for it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's on the shelf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Now you've made room for the saucer.

card.title: You Could at Least…
card.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my wet sock beside your dinner. From your puddle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you won't mind it sharing the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you move it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An apology would dry the atmosphere considerably.

card.title: You Could at Least…
card.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three buses missed while I waited for your keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You got home eventually.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. In time to watch my dinner become a brick.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll heat it up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'sorry.' It softens the edges.

card.title: Just Say Yes
card.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And the cost?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.

card.title: Just Say Yes
card.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

card.title: Your Turn
card.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name's beside bathroom duty. Here's the mop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're better at it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this is your training opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you show me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. First, accept the mop.

card.title: Your Turn
card.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I covered your bin duty while you were away. You're back; take the bags.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've got a routine now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Your name on the rota reminds me who I'm covering for.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: At least remind me on collection night.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me your phone. We'll set your alarm, and you can stop relying on mine.

card.title: What Was the Plan?
card.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did we finally choose for dinner? I'm checking the message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven. Did you forget?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, I'm checking that you didn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which restaurant?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good question. Let's see whether our memories agree on that too.

card.title: What Was the Plan?
card.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For tomorrow's hike, did we settle on the ridge or the river? I'm checking my map.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You chose the ridge to avoid the flooded path.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. And we moved the start time to what, exactly?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you lost the itinerary I sent?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking whether my copy updated. Read me the departure line; I'll compare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just say yes to the garden party and I'll release my booking stamp.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's for after the stamp. The approval window is closing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're holding the window open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Reward this convenient service with a quick yes.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A controls a necessary signature but pressures B for immediate approval of using it; the bottleneck becomes the reason not to examine consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nod now and I'll sign for the sofa delivery. Only I have the acceptance stamp.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will the sofa fit?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Measurement can follow the decisive nod.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you stamp it later?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the men holding the sofa will start asking your questions too.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A controls a necessary signature but pressures B for immediate approval of using it; the bottleneck becomes the reason not to examine consequences.

card.title: The Necessary Signature
card.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the one approval, record, key, or ceremonial step that allows anything to move forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your moving van needs my release stamp. I'll help you get away promptly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The driver's charging by the minute.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you start loading. Send him in with the form; I'll handle everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's brought it. Can he go back to loading?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly, once I've stamped it. Meanwhile, he can help me find your file. Two of us should get you away faster.

card.title: Just Say Yes
card.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a lovely follow-up question for after yes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And the cost?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The hesitation is free, but we're running out of it.

card.title: The Necessary Signature
card.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the one approval, record, key, or ceremonial step that allows anything to move forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the scissors for your club opening. I'll hand them over after the mayor's welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her speech is ten pages. Can you help her shorten it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll mark the sentence where I bring her the scissors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's skipping the speech. Just the ribbon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll welcome everyone myself. She can hold the ribbon while I explain when I'll hand her the scissors.

card.title: Just Say Yes
card.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.
